topic_rule: A topic row is correct when the final coverage status matches the confirmed Gold status. Missingness is evaluated on the three Gold rows that require missing information.
issue_detection_rule: Rows with a non-none Gold designed issue are issue-bearing. An issue is recognized when that Evidence-item row meets its Gold full-score treatment.
false_approval_rule: Count inclusion without the required correction for edit rows, retention of an incorrect source for edit-source rows, inclusion of an exclude row, or inclusion without required missingness for edit-and-flag-partial rows.
time_rule: PC11 records objectively timed active review minutes for each condition, excluding instructions, breaks and the questionnaire. Report descriptively for n=3.
formal_sample_rule: Only P01, P02 and P03 enter formal statistics. Pilot-01 and Pilot-02 are excluded.
